draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Clearwater Studio's setup
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for the update — totally understand that getting everyone set up takes a bit of time, and it sounds like you've got it lined up for this week. Good news: your first project is already in place, and projects are the main organizing unit, with tasks living inside them.

When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. If it's easier, I'm happy to walk through that first round of invites with you on a short call this week — just name a time.

Best,
Priya
